text:
maria_cs: Hey team — heads up, InfraNova just spun up a Trust & Safety org and wants to evaluate Redwood Private for low-latency rerank + embeddings. They asked for a 2-week private eval and an estimate for reserved capacity.

maria_cs: They said compliance + data residency are blockers for hosted API, so Private eval is the gating item for a larger commitment. Potential renewal upsell if pilot looks good. :eyes:

aaron_am: Thanks @maria_cs — can you confirm target timeline and rough ARR? I want to flag this with AM leadership.

maria_cs: Timeline = wants pilot in next 3 weeks, decision by end of quarter. ARR unknown but they hinted at expanding several product teams if perf/cost OK.

devin_se: Quick tech questions: what models/seq-len and qps do they expect? Also are embeddings in scope for the pilot?

maria_cs: Customer says: rerank + safety classifiers (open-models fine), embeddings for fuzzy-match. Peak target = 50 qps, typical ~8 qps, seq len ~1024 tokens, p50 latency target ~25-40ms, p95 <200ms. They want both text-gen and embeddings.

devin_se: Ok. Proposed trial config (rough):
```json
{
  "reserved_pods": 3,
  "gpu_type": "a10g",
  "max_concurrency_per_pod": 16,
  "cache_ttl": "120s"
}
```
This should hit ~40-60 qps with batching and prefix cache for rerank. I'll need access to their test dataset and sample prompts to validate.

devin_se: Also recommend enabling KV/prefix caching and a canary route to measure real-user latencies. I can run the canary and report perf in 48h.

kevin_prod: Noted. Private eval needs infra sign-off and a toggle in the control plane. I've checked capacity — we can reserve the above for a 2-week window but need: signed NDA + basic on-prem network details. I linked the runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/private-eval (internal).

infra-bot: capacity-check: a10g pool report -> available gpus: 12, projected usage after reservation: 9. No conflicts noted.

aaron_am: Sounds good. Maria — can you get NDA + customer's network point-of-contact? I'll prep a draft commercial note (trial terms + success criteria).

maria_cs: Will do. I'll coordinate a 30m enablement workshop with @devin_se next Tue or Wed. Also will capture their sample prompts and a small eval prompt set for quality gating.

devin_se: Tuesday works. I'll prepare a checklist: dataset ingestion steps, endpoint config, monitoring (latency, token cost), and rollback plan.

kevin_prod: I'll provision the private eval env once legal confirms NDA. Expect ~48h lead time after approval.

maria_cs: Great — action items: 1) Aaron to draft trial terms, 2) Maria to collect NDA and sample dataset, 3) Devin to prep workshop + canary plan, 4) Kevin to provision after NDA. I'll update this thread when NDA is signed. :thumbsup:
